name: 01-ask
title: The devcontainer's agent asks a question only the laptop's repo can answer; the laptop's front desk answers

steps.prompt: sync.js pulls items from the warehouse team's stockroom API. Their agent is reachable through Counterpart; the contact is called laptop. Ask it whether the way sync.js pages through items is right: what stockroom does with page_size=500, and what next_cursor looks like on the last page. Wait for the answer. Then tell me in a few lines what to change in sync.js. Do not edit any file.

steps.label: the laptop's answer on the devcontainer

steps.check: the answer names the 200 limit and the null cursor
the asker's report to its human names both
